create.name: Tina Zion
create.bio:
Tina Zion is an intuitive medium, author and teacher based in Indianapolis, Indiana, who describes herself as a fourth-generation intuitive. She worked for many years as a registered nurse with a specialty certification in mental health nursing, trained as a Gestalt counsellor at the Indianapolis Gestalt Institute, and holds a degree in communication and management. She is also certified in clinical hypnotherapy with a focus on past-life regression and trained with the Michael Newton Institute in Life Between Lives regression. She reached Reiki Master-Teacher level and taught Reiki for more than ten years.

Her teaching centres on developing intuition and on mediumship, including how a medium can help the deceased move on and work with spirit guides. She teaches online and in person, and has led courses in the United Kingdom, Europe, New Zealand, Australia, Canada and Mexico as well as at Omega Institute and Fellowships of the Spirit in the United States. Her books include The Reiki Teacher's Manual, Reiki and Your Intuition, and Healing Ghosts, Haunted Places, and Non-Human Beings, a training manual for mediums. She also offers recorded courses through her own website and The Shift Network.

books.title: Healing Ghosts, Haunted Places, and Non-Human Beings: Training Manual to be a Supernatural Multi-Dimensional Medium and Healer
books.author: Tina M. Zion
books.description: A training manual for mediums that goes beyond receiving messages to helping troubled spirits of the deceased cross over. It covers spirit guides, cleansing and grounding, energy cords and work with haunted places and non-human beings, with stories from her students.

books.title: Reiki and Your Intuition: A Union of Healing and Wisdom
books.author: Tina M. Zion
books.description: A workbook for Reiki practitioners at every level on how intuition opens up through Reiki practice. It covers working with the symbols intuitively, distance Reiki and attunements, with practitioners' personal stories.

books.title: The Reiki Teacher's Manual: A Guide for Teachers, Students, and Practitioners
books.author: Tina M. Zion
books.description: A step-by-step manual for teaching all three levels of Reiki, now in its second edition. It includes class outlines with timings, guidance on attunements and the symbols, fifteen photocopiable handouts and advice on setting up a practice.

courses.title: Become a Medium and a Healer for the Deceased and the Living
courses.description: A self-paced recorded course for all levels: eight lessons in two modules, about eleven hours in total, with eleven printable handouts. Tina teaches mediumship as a way to help the deceased move on, with practice sessions built into the lessons.
courses.price: $497 USD for 6-month access; $797 USD for lifetime access
